purpose: Loaded PHP and Symfony development, CLI tasks, unit and PostgreSQL integration tests.
limitations: Project PHP dependencies come from Composer lockfiles.
Xdebug is off by default; enable with XDEBUG_MODE=coverage or debug.
No PHP-FPM, web server daemon, or Node toolchain is supplied.

changes: Accept a mounted multi-certificate PEM CA bundle; validate all certificates before replacing managed trust and retain single-certificate and root/user behavior.
8.4-trixie.migration: Compatible CA setup fix. Continue using the normal root entrypoint and mount a certificate or PEM bundle read-only through LIBRARY_CA_FILE (CA_CERTIFICATE in wrappers). Existing explicit Composer/Node CA settings and PUID/PGID behavior remain supported. Published pins stay unchanged until deliberately upgraded to a verified release.
